identity.code: authored: things are signed conditions, not natures; persons inviolable
identity.note: Things have no natures or tendencies, only conditions, and every change carries its maker's name, so a thing is legibly the record of who changed it. Persons are the only givers and no one else can alter them except by giving them store. Social identity is ledgered: rank is standing; a child begins as its parents' debtor and comes of age at the Squaring, when that first debt is paid; a person out of store is stilled and kept like a thing until someone wakes them.

scarcity.code: store fixed, shrinking; pace capped by standing; waking costs; clutter stays
scarcity.note: Store is how much you can do; the world's total never grows and every breaking shrinks it. Standing is how fast, and it rests on others' unpaid debt, so being repaid slows you. Thinking and perceiving cost about a measure a waking hour, so the poor unmake memories to stay awake and then are stilled. Nothing rots, washes away or wears out, so clearing leftovers and the works of the still takes paid labour. Great works need great standing or a crowd, since every effect is paid by hand.

information_flow.code: every change signed and kept; words hang where said; messages go by hand
information_flow.note: Nothing is forgotten on its own: memory is perfect, records last for free, and spoken words hang where they were said until unsaid, last speaker first. Every change carries its maker's name, readable by anyone who looks closely, so every question of why something changed has a findable name; courts listen to a scene and read its signatures. Action and speech work only by touch or in place, so messages must be carried. Seeing needs no light but costs the seer store. Only debt reaches anyone at any range.

boundary_structure.code: person/thing divide; a witness makes gifts binding; walls only for privacy
boundary_structure.note: The main divide is between persons, who give, and things, which only receive and keep; a stilled person, with no store to give, is kept like a thing until woken. One third-person witness divides binding gifts from quiet ones, so walls, needless against weather, matter for controlling who sees and hears. Contact bounds all action, and debt alone crosses distance. Each thing's changes form a stack whose top only its maker can undo, so another's work on top seals yours. Breaking is the world's one exit for store.

permitted_transformations.code: any paid change, cost = size, no transmission; maker undo until overwritten
permitted_transformations.note: Any change to a thing is allowed if paid for by touch at a cost equal to its size, in any direction, since there is no up or down; motion is a paid journey that stops where paid. Things cannot pass a change on, so no effect causes another. A person can change another only by giving store, which cannot be refused. The maker alone can undo, for a full refund, while nothing has changed the thing since. Witnessed breaking makes a change permanent and deletes its store; others may still build over it.

enforcement.code: automatic: debts self-collect oldest-first at any range; custom curbs binding
enforcement.note: The rules are physical and exceptionless: nothing changes unpaid, and while you owe, every measure you give any person goes first to your creditors, oldest first, wherever they are; spending on things or yourself is exempt. Custom works against this law rather than mirroring it: a Giving must include a witness the receiver invited, unasked gifts are limited, and quiet gifts help without binding. Courts enforce by listening to hanging words and reading makers' names; reckoners trace debt chains and redirected payments.

concepts.label: Relational support by conserved load paths
concepts.operator: Any configuration steeper than its material's repose generates an outward demand that grows superlinearly with its height; the ambient medium answers it only up to a threshold scale, and the thing can never answer it itself. The remainder is answered only by one-sided contact from the side the demand points toward. Equal opposing demands cancel; unequal ones pass their difference cumulatively along unbroken contact chains to a single sink, which accepts it only when enough ballast accompanies it. Removing any link unanswers everything upstream at once, and unanswered excess relaxes the configuration irreversibly toward its ground state, so ascent requires temporary scaffolding.
differentia: Stability is extrinsic, conserved and passively borne: not a property of the thing, not paid by ongoing effort, not dissipated with distance, but a standing load carried by neighbors and routed to a ground sink. Its signature consequences are density economies through cancellation, the whole net burden at the outer boundary and cumulative at chain ends, weight as both liability (when raised) and asset (when grounding), instant upstream cascades, and ratcheting loss.
Standing holding mode: a configuration paid once in ballast or anchorage, with no running cost; its demand is signed, so equal opposing demands cancel.
concepts.boundary: Same regime (instance or alias) when only the carried quantity (thrust, obligation, debt), the bearer, the input that generates demand (height, rank, speed), the threshold, the scaling exponent, the sink ratio or the ground-state shape changes. New regime when the primary operator changes: things can hold themselves up (intrinsic strength or tension); the demand decays along the chain instead of being conserved; it is paid by effort per unit time rather than borne statically; equal opposing demands add instead of cancelling; or there is no sink, so demand must circulate or be stored. Changing only the failure semantics (reversible slumps, no centering needed) is a candidate specialization, not a new regime; a world keeping the ratchet and scaffolding but dropping conserved routing belongs to a different regime.

concepts.label: Observational upkeep: specific detail persists only under unbroken, resolution-limited attention, and the holder carries the decay it prevents as a burden shed only in rest
concepts.operator: Specific detail drains spontaneously and one way: first to its kind's typical form, then down a ladder of kinds to a Ground that needs no holding. Drain is fastest on the intricate and new, near nil on the typical. The only counter is unbroken attention by an active, discerning holder. It only keeps: it never creates or restores, and it resists net loss of detail, not motion or accretion, harder the more is at stake. It holds exactly what some holder can resolve, a resolution set by sense, distance, breadth and understanding, pooled across holders. Gaps under a grace interval do not count, so relays must overlap. Holding is a running act: the drain it prevents is conserved, accruing in the holder as burden for as long as it holds. Co-holders share it, each holder has a capacity, and overflow drains the holder's own detail. Burden discharges only in the holder's rest, when it holds nothing and must itself be held. Unbroken holding accrues tenure superlinearly with span, and a break restarts the count; tenure shields the unwatched thing until spent. Kinds sum the tenure of all their members, so old kinds are deep attractors and a new kind falls into the nearest old one.
differentia: Against regime.relational-load-path: holding is running, not standing. Load paths cost nothing once built and ballasted; upkeep costs burden for every moment held and forces the holder into periodic rest, where it must be held in turn, so relays, rotas and a daily tide replace a fixed structure. The conserved quantity is unsigned and never cancels, only moves or is shared in parallel, whereas opposing loads cancel. Fidelity is bounded by the holder's representation (grain), which contact support lacks. Continuity is stored as tenure, so failure is delayed and local, not an instant upstream cascade. The ground is a nested, history-weighted ladder of typical forms rather than one repose state, and an active holder can partly hold itself.
concepts.boundary: In: worlds where specific detail, form or memory lasts only while an active holder attends to it without a break; the holder keeps but never makes or restores; and the decay held off is charged to the holder over time and must be discharged in rest. Instance-level changes: who holds (animals, machines, spirits, the dead), which senses set the grain, the grace length, the tenure exponent, the rest mechanism. Out, as candidate siblings or splits: (1) observation that creates, selects or collapses states is generative, not keep-only; (2) periodic re-performance that restores lost detail (ritual refresh, recopying) is restorative, whereas vigil restores nothing; (3) protection that costs the holder nothing, or burns a fuel while the prevented decay reappears nowhere, lacks the conserved burden; (4) holding by a standing configuration with no running cost belongs to regime.relational-load-path under the shared parent; (5) drift toward prototypes with no holder at all (pure tradition attractors) would split off this regime's kind-tenure clause rather than join it. Borderline test: does the prevented decay reappear in the holder, and does protection end when attention breaks for longer than the grace?

concepts.label: Held metastability: excess order persists only while a holder answers its relaxation, and holding moves the unbalanced pressure into the holder, never dissolving it
concepts.operator: A state above its ground carries a one-way pressure to relax toward that ground. The state cannot answer the pressure by its form alone; the answer must come from a holder, which is a structure or an act distinct from what it holds. Holding does not dissolve the unbalanced pressure: it moves it into the holder, which must pass it to a sink. Holders therefore need holding, holding capacity is the scarce resource, the amount of order a world can carry is bounded by that capacity, and whatever is raised or new needs intensive temporary holding until it sets. Unanswered excess relaxes irreversibly.
differentia: Separates worlds whose order is kept by a conserved pressure routed through holders from worlds whose ordered states sustain themselves (stable attractors, autocatalysis, self-repair), worlds where decay is only slowed by barriers that bear nothing, and worlds where upkeep burns a fuel without the prevented decay reappearing anywhere. Children are cut by holding mode. Standing: a configuration pays once (ballast, anchorage), transmits instantly, keeps no memory and fails as an instant upstream cascade (regime.relational-load-path). Running: an act pays per unit time held, forces holder rest, stores continuity as tenure and fails gradually (regime.observational-upkeep).
concepts.boundary: Introduced as a hypothesis on the second world. Keep it only if a later world falls under it without fitting either child, or if the standing/running cut predicts a world's consequences (instant cascade versus tenure; fixed structures versus rotas and rest). Collapse it if every later member is plainly one child. Not a home for every world where things decay without care: membership needs one-way relaxation to a ground, holding by a structure or act distinct from the held form, and the unbalanced pressure reappearing in the holder and passing to a sink. Possible further children: periodic re-performance, if the prevented decay still lands on the performers; hybrids in which a standing structure must also be tended.

concepts.label: Twinned induction: things are conserved signed turnings of one medium, born and cancelled only in opposite twins; nothing moves or feeds itself; each is carried and fed by others' stir
concepts.operator: Every thing is a standing turning of one medium that can only flow; it keeps no material, only its pattern. Each carries a signed, conserved turn. Turn is made only together with an equal twin of opposite sign; equal opposites meeting annihilate into fine paired spray, which is heat; like signs within a threshold merge, and unlike ones cancel in part. Nothing can move or sustain itself. Each thing is carried and fed only by the flow the others induce, instantly and at any range, fading with distance. So like signs circle their shared center; an equal opposite pair travels straight, faster the closer, and an unequal pair curves toward the stronger; a lone thing goes only where ambient flow carries it or along a boundary, which answers it with an opposite-signed mirror partner. A turning lasts only inside a band of ambient shear: too little and it unravels, spreading its turn diffusely; too much and it is torn to spray. Every turning is also a sink that draws the medium into an inward spiral with no stable orbit, so all things drift toward some eye.
differentia: Against held metastability: decay is answered not by a distinct holder that takes on the displaced pressure, but by the pattern itself consuming an ambient gradient; nothing accrues in a supplier, no holder needs rest or holding, and failure is two-sided (starving or tearing), not one-way relaxation of excess. What is conserved is the order's own signed quantity, not the pressure against it: death spreads turn, never destroys it. Power is pairing, not bearing or keeping: a thing moves only with an opposite partner or its mirror at a wall, and every steer is a conserved transfer of turn. Interaction is an instant long-range field in which opposites cancel, not contact chains or attention.
concepts.boundary: Inside: worlds whose things are signed, conserved quantities that arise and cancel only in opposite sets and cannot move themselves, moving only in the field the others induce, whatever the medium, names, ranges or thresholds. Changing the merge distance, the field's fall-off, the shear-scaling law, the width of the livable band, the number of signs (if they are made only in cancelling sets), or dropping the world-whirl changes parameters, not the regime. The feed band is part of the operator as found here; a world that keeps twins and company-only motion but lets things last unfed stays inside as a specialization under a persistence cut, not a new root. Outside, to held metastability: worlds where order is kept by a structure or act distinct from it that takes on the displaced pressure and must pass it to a sink or shed it in rest. Rote reciters here resemble vigil keepers but supply feed, not holding: nothing accrues in them and nothing is shed. Outside, to relational load path: worlds where opposing demands cancel statically and the net passes through contact chains to a ballasted sink; here cancellation is annihilation or co-travel, imbalance steers, and there is no contact. Outside, as regimes still to be admitted: throughput-fed patterns with unsigned quantities or self-propulsion, which share only the feed band and would justify a 'fed pattern' parent opposed to held metastability; and conserved signed charges that act by contact or push themselves, which lack company-only motion.

concepts.label: Paid change: unattended state is kept exactly; every change is an agent's conserved, signed expenditure, lodged in what it changed and refundable only by its maker until overwritten
concepts.operator: Things have no natures or tendencies, only conditions, and an unattended condition is kept exactly: nothing falls, coasts, cools, decays or is forgotten; there is no ground, up or down. The only cause is an agent spending a single conserved currency by direct touch; a change in any direction costs currency equal to its size. Non-agents receive and keep change but never pass it on, so there are no mechanisms, chains or cascades. Spent currency is not consumed: it lodges in the change, signed by its maker, who alone can undo it for a full refund, and only while nothing has changed that thing since, so later work locks earlier work in stack order. No agent can take another's currency or alter another; it can only give currency, which cannot be refused. A witnessed transfer between agents creates an exact, permanent, bilaterally netted obligation that seizes the debtor's later agent-directed outflows, oldest creditor first, at any range. Witnessed renunciation fixes a change forever and deletes its currency from the world, so total currency only shrinks. What an agent is owed, plus what it has renounced, sets how fast it can spend.
differentia: Against answered decay: there the unattended drifts and persistence must be supplied, by a holder that bears the displaced pressure or by a feed nobody bears; here the unattended is kept exactly and only change is bought, once, in any direction. Against observational upkeep, its nearest by shared structure, it is the dual: acts only change, keeping is free, and the maker can restore. The spent quantity is not a live pressure passed to a sink but an inert, signed deposit only its maker can reclaim, so making is saving and every change is attributable and reversible until built over. Causation is agent-only and contact-only, with no transmission through things; only debt seizure acts at range. A coupled binding operator turns the ledger into rank: being owed sets pace.
concepts.boundary: Necessary: the unattended state is kept exactly, with no spontaneous dynamics of any kind (no relaxation, momentum, diffusion or decay), and every change is caused by an agent paying for it, at a cost set by its size, by direct action on the thing. Full fit adds what the first instance shows: the payment is conserved, lodged in the change under its maker's name and reclaimable only by the maker until overwritten; witnessed transfers between agents create netted obligations that seize outflows; being owed sets pace; renunciation destroys currency. A world that keeps inert state and paid change but dissipates the payment (no refunds, no signatures) is a partial fit and the test of a partition by the fate of spent currency; one that drops binding, or binds without tying rate to claims, is a partial fit and the test of a partition by what a transfer between agents does. Out: any world where something changes unattended, even slowly, belongs under answered decay, even if agents also pay for change; worlds whose stillness is itself held by an agent's act (a freeze that must be sustained) are held metastability, since there keeping is what is paid. A world where change propagates through things (levers, contagion, chains of cause) has a mechanism rather than this operator. Newtonian inertia is out, because there motion coasts and here nothing does. Occasionalist worlds in which one agent causes every change at no cost are out too: nothing is paid, so nothing is ledgered.

concepts.label: Answered decay: left alone, a thing's state does not stay; it relaxes, lapses, unravels or drifts, and it lasts only while something outside it answers that tendency
concepts.operator: Every ordered thing is off the rest point of some spontaneous tendency: relaxation toward a ground, lapse toward the typical, unravelling, or an inward spiral. It cannot answer the tendency by its own form; it lasts only while something outside it does, and unanswered it degrades irreversibly. What must be supplied is persistence, not change: the unattended changes by itself, and effort or feed goes into staying. Worlds under this concept differ in what answers and what answering costs the answerer: a distinct holder that takes the displaced pressure into itself and must pass or shed it, failing one way, by relaxation, when holding lapses; or an ambient feed that others induce and nothing bears, failing two ways, by starving or tearing. Scarcity follows the answer: holding capacity where the answer is borne, a livable band of feed where it is not.
differentia: Names the premise that held metastability and twinned induction share and that stayed invisible until a world lacked it: the unattended drifts, so persistence has to be supplied. Their recorded opposition, borne holder versus unborne feed, becomes this concept's partition (by-answerer). The contrast class is paid change, where the unattended is kept exactly and only change is bought, so effort goes into altering rather than staying.
concepts.boundary: In: any world whose things have a spontaneous tendency away from their present state (toward a ground, the typical, dispersal or a sink) and persist only through an outside answer, whether a holder, a feed, a field or an act, and whether the answer is paid once or per moment. Both former roots sit here unchanged: held metastability under the borne branch, twinned induction under the unborne branch. Out: worlds where the unattended state is kept exactly (paid change); worlds whose unattended states change without degrading toward any rest point, such as purely reversible oscillation, which neither this concept nor paid change covers and which should be admitted on its own if it appears. A world with a slow drift plus paid change stays in, because some persistence must still be answered.

partitions.lens: holding mode: standing (a configuration paid once in ballast or anchorage; instant transmission; no memory; instant upstream cascade) versus running (an act paid per moment held; compulsory holder rest in which the holder must be held; stored tenure; gradual failure)

what answers the tendency: borne (a distinct holder takes the displaced pressure and must pass or shed it; failure is one-way relaxation) versus unborne (an ambient feed that others induce; nothing accrues in suppliers; failure is two-sided, starving or tearing)

relations.label: cancellation: load-path's equal opposing demands cancel, while vigil's lapse is never cancelled, only moved or shared
failure dynamics: instant total failure upstream when a link goes, versus tenure-buffered, local, gradual lapse

analogies, not identities: unbroken contact chain and overlapping relay within the grace; scaffolding and curing vigils; withdrawing support and averting or the Turning; ballasted sink and sleep under a night-keeper; height and thisness at stake; repose and the Ground or the typical

what answers decay: a pattern fed by an ambient gradient that nothing bears, versus a distinct holder that takes on the displaced pressure and must pass or shed it; two-sided failure (starve or tear) versus one-way relaxation
analogies, not identities: equal opposites cancel and only the net acts; the outer boundary completes the balance; one missing element sets the whole going

how imbalance acts: cancellation by annihilation or co-travel in a contactless field where imbalance steers motion, versus static cancellation passed by contact chains to a ballasted sink with instant upstream collapse
analogies, not identities: rote reciters and carousel archives against the unbroken watch; the unfed widen into faint swirls as the unwatched go typical; a sealed room is a small Eye
feed, not borne burden: nothing accrues in the suppliers, and there is no compulsory rest, tenure or ladder of kinds
default of the unattended and what effort buys: exact keeping, so only change is bought, once and in any direction, with no ground, versus a drift that persistence must answer
what the outlay becomes: an inert, signed deposit only its maker can reclaim, so making is saving, versus a live pressure moved into a holder that must pass it to a sink

change-only versus keep-only: here acts only alter, keeping is free and the maker’s undo restores for a full refund; there the watch only keeps and nothing restores; unwatched records last forever versus only while watched

analogies, not identities: debt and burden, conserved loads that accrue in persons, never fade and end only by a specific act (repayment or forgiveness versus rest); standing earned by unreturned giving and tenure by unbroken keeping; the stilled, kept until woken, and the resting keeper who must be held; perception as a paid running act
what dependency does to removal: work built on top locks the buried change against its maker’s undo, versus removing a link unanswers everything upstream at once; here building needs no support

analogies, not identities: one netted balance per pair, where only the net binds, and equal opposing demands that cancel so only their difference acts; reckoners tracing debt chains and redirected payments, and net load passed along contact chains

analogies, not identities: a witnessed gift makes an equal and opposite pair, the receiver’s debt and the giver’s claim, which repayment annihilates and over-repayment flips, as turn is made and unmade only in opposite twins; things cannot move themselves; debt seizure is the one action at range, like stir
who pays for what: every change is paid by a self-moving agent’s touch in an inert world, versus nothing paid, with things fed and carried by contactless induced flow and unable to last or move alone
